title: PeakHold
description: Numeric widgets with a peak-hold marker (NUM-110).

peak_hold.description: Track and show the highest value (NUM-110).

peak_decay.description: Seconds after which the held peak is released at the next value; 0: held until reset.

peak.description: Held peak, null when none. Derived from the history of value (time dependent): by the host when it owns the state, otherwise by the front end (HOST-004).
